notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Pronoun supplied as object of 'stanapim'; Hebrew carries it in the infinitive suffix.

notes.subject: olgeta bikman bilong ol papa
notes.rationale: ראשי האבות: heads of father-houses, clan chiefs of the returnees.

notes.subject: freewill offering
notes.rationale: Beginning of the offering account for rebuilding the house of Elohim on its foundation.

translation: Na olgeta bikman bilong ol papa bilong ol, taim ol i kamap long haus bilong Yahwe we i stap long Yerusalayim, ol i givim ofa long laik bilong ol yet long haus bilong Elohim bilong stanapim ⟨את⟩ em long ples bilong em.

tokens.gloss: na olgeta bikman bilong ol papa
ol i givim ofa long laik bilong ol yet
